Of 39 journal rows inspected the exit_reason histogram is {None x26, reconciler_filled x6, pairs_revert x4, pairs_stop x2, netting_attributed x1} -- ZERO clean bracket exits, so ZERO bucket-A gradeable rows. All 14 paper closes are unmeasured (pnlMeasuredCount 0, pnlEstimatedCount 8, pnlUnverifiedCount 6, pnlCoverage 0.0). The paper book's -$226.46 / 21.4% win rate is a RECORD-QUALITY ARTIFACT, not a strategy signal, and must not be read as one. This is the 2026-06-26 shape recurring (docs/audits/order-packages-zero-qty-2026-06-26.md, 0/48 gradeable).

proposed_tweaks.proposed_value: a real target, or removal of the sentinel
proposed_tweaks.evidence: pkg-349cebc854c04ff7: entry 82.255, sl 82.5836, tp 74.1118 -- tp_r=50.0 against risk_per_unit 0.3286 on a 1h bond pullback. A 50R take-profit is a sentinel, not a plan; the leg never reaches it, so the exit is whatever the trail/stop does.

real_money_allocation_benchmark.proposed_action: Re-pose the benchmark as reallocation, not addition. The sleeve does not need free capital to be evaluated -- it needs a named incumbent position to be compared against.
real_money_allocation_benchmark.note: does_not_clear FOR WANT OF A MEASURABLE CANDIDATE, not on the merits -- an important distinction. alpaca_portfolio reads balance=$99,609.11 with available_usd=$53.90 and returned 'risk_refused: sized_qty=0' on the tlt_pullback_1h dispatch: a book that cannot take a position is not an execution proxy, and any correlation/drawdown estimate would be measuring refusals. The incumbent side is also too thin to compare (1 closed trade, n=1, expectancy_r over a single row). Paper-proxy caveat stands regardless: alpaca_live is dry_run and logs packages without filling. | CORRECTED: the candidate proxy is not BROKEN, it is FULLY INVESTED (longs $98,776.34 of a $99,600.29 balance, 99.2%). So the benchmark is not blocked by a fault -- it is mis-posed: 'does adding this sleeve help' has no answer on a book with no free capital. Re-pose it as REALLOCATION (what would this sleeve replace, and does the swap improve risk-adjusted outcome) rather than addition.

anomalies.correction: CORRECTED 2026-08-11T18:25Z after the operator challenged the framing, and they were RIGHT. This is NOT a defect. alpaca_portfolio holds 8 open positions whose LONGS ALONE are $98,776.34 against a $99,600.29 balance -- 99.2% deployed. available_usd $53.90 is the arithmetic consequence of a fully-invested book, and 'risk_refused: sized_qty=0' is the RiskManager working correctly: refusing a trade it cannot fund, and logging the exact reason. Calling it 'silently refusing' was wrong on both counts -- it is neither silent nor a fault. WHAT SURVIVES is smaller and different in kind: a fully-invested mirror cannot answer the allocation benchmark AS POSED, because that question is 'does ADDING this sleeve help' and there is nothing to add with -- the question becomes REALLOCATION. Two facts worth keeping from the check: gross exposure is 2.01x ($200,619.78 on $99,600.29 at entry prices), a real reading for the exposure-soak distribution which currently has almost none; and IWM alone is 56.9% of the book ($56,666.61). Neither is a defect; both are facts about how the mirror is positioned.

The strategy-refinement-queue schema lets `next_step` go stale against `resweep_results` on the SAME item: SRQ-20260618-001/002 have said 'REMAINING: run the re-sweep' since 2026-06-18 while carrying three rounds of completed results and a decisive holdout failure. A field that says work is pending while the field below it records the answer will keep producing sessions that re-dispatch finished work -- it produced one today. Fix is schema-level (next_step must be derived from, or asserted against, the newest evidence entry), not another manual edit.

recommended_action: CORRECTED. The window is ungradeable and that remains true -- but it does NOT gate the program, and saying it did was the error. Per the fast-gate doctrine the confidence gate is OFFLINE, so the real queue is the 29 open items with an unrun backtest/sweep, not a wait for live rows. (B) ACCOUNTING -- the 0-of-14-measured record, the NULL-exit close (trade 4575), and the missed primary stuck-cascade path, which matter for provenance and for /health-review but block no strategy decision. The two Tier-3 tweaks stay gated on (A) -- specifically SRQ-20260618-002 -- and neither value may be fitted from a 37h window. || CORRECTED AGAIN 2026-08-11T19:10Z: do NOT read '29 runnable sweeps' as a verified queue -- that count came from a keyword match on items MENTIONING a backtest, and the three I checked had already been run to a decisive negative. DOCTRINE ERROR, and it is the most important correction of this review. I dispositioned ~43 backlog items and this review's recommended_action citing LIVE ACCRUAL as the blocker ('re-check when gradeable rows accrue'), and closed by calling 'why exits aren't recording' the highest-value question in the program. That inverts the fast-gate doctrine: exit-refinement P4 states 'The offline validation IS the confidence gate' (operator directive 2026-07-12), and P5 scopes live to MECHANICAL verification over hours-days -- parity and first-decision sanity -- NEVER accruing statistical confidence. Measured after the correction: 29 of 53 open items have a backtest-shaped next step and are runnable offline NOW; 7 named live accrual as their blocker, 6 of those also backtest-runnable. The record/provenance problem is a real ACCOUNTING track but it does not gate the strategy-evidence program. 27 items re-stamped with review_2026_08_11_correction.

SECOND correction to my own correction, and it is the same defect class I spent the day fixing. Having accepted the operator's fast-gate point, I claimed '29 of 53 open items have a backtest-shaped next step and are runnable offline NOW' and told the operator two SRQ items had 'read REMAINING since 2026-06-18, waiting on a sweep nobody dispatched'. BOTH WRONG. My classifier keyword-matched on 'sweep'/'walk-forward'/'k-fold', which detects an item that MENTIONS a backtest -- not one that NEEDS one. That is an unasserted denominator. Checked SRQ-20260618-001/002 directly: the re-sweep RAN on 2026-06-18, in three rounds (flat ADX-20 A/B, per-cell 15/20/25/30 threshold sweep finding 4 of 10 cells at every-fold pass, then a holdout check that killed all four as in-sample artifacts breaking at k=6/k=7/train_frac 0.35-0.45). A clean completed NEGATIVE, which is a finished deliverable. Their `next_step` field still says 'REMAINING' while `resweep_results` three fields below records the answer -- a stale-field defect that is precisely what led me to assert pending work. The 53 backlog items carry NO structured evidence field at all, so I cannot claim they are unrun either: the honest state is UNVERIFIED, not 29-runnable. What survives unchanged is the DOCTRINE point (offline validation is the confidence gate; live accrual is not the blocker) -- only my count of what follows from it was wrong.
